curated-fs-new-title-gf-noto-sans-mro: New Title links tall lowercase like a chain, say in a guidelines deck. Noto Sans Mro sits underneath with dense, tall-middled words and wide entrances into each letter, keeping the display lines grounded.
curated-fs-new-title-gf-noto-sans-psalte: New Title links tall lowercase together like a fine chain, bold and modern (think a guidelines deck). Noto Sans Psalter Pahlavi stays low and approachable, its e wide-mouthed and its capitals barely rising.
curated-fs-new-title-gf-noto-sans-rejang: Noto Sans Rejang opens its lowercase into wide glass portholes, as an event sponsorship deck might want. And New Title does the loud work, its tall lowercase locked like chain links.
curated-fs-new-title-gf-noto-sans-syriac: New Title is bold and modern, with tall lowercase and letters linked like a fine chain. Noto Sans Syriac Eastern reads approachably, its curves never crowding each other.
curated-fs-new-title-gf-odor-mean-chey: Tall and chained: New Title, say for a yoga logo. New Title does the bold, modern shouting, while Odor Mean Chey brings dignified editorial text with squeezed a, e and s.
curated-fs-new-title-gf-oxygen: Oxygen has lowercase nearly matching its capitals, with curves left open. New Title's tall, chain-linked lowercase gets a clean, contemporary partner in that sans-serif text, which keeps the loud display lines company.
curated-fs-new-title-gf-parkinsans: Crisp, wide-mouthed body text sits under a tall, chained display face. Parkinsans keeps one stroke thickness throughout, so shrinking New Title would lose its chain-link charm while Parkinsans stays sharp.
curated-fs-new-title-gf-ramabhadra: Modern in spirit, New Title links tall lowercase like a fine chain. Give the heading room at display sizes, and let Ramabhadra, with its prominent x-height, carry the clean text beneath.
curated-fs-new-title-gf-rum-raisin: Clean and snug, Rum Raisin has large-eyed lowercase (handy for a real estate logo). And New Title takes the bold lead up top, its tall lowercase linked like chain, with Rum Raisin keeping the text tight.
curated-fs-new-title-manrope: Chain-link headings meet a marker-like body line (a jewelry stamp, say). New Title leads with tall lowercase, then Manrope keeps its pen line at one width, so paragraphs read smoothly and approachably.
